rationale.consistency: Mirrors CookieFilter exactly: same struct shape, Validate, module ID naming, Caddyfile subdirectives, and interface guards; registered beside the cookie filter.
rationale.edge_cases: Unparsable lines pass through, quoting preserved, delete drops the value, exact name match, attribute suffix kept verbatim; leading whitespace before the name is silently dropped on rebuild, and non-array fields are returned untouched.
rationale.scope: Only adds the new filter, registration and interface guards; no unrelated edits or refactors.
rationale.readability: Clear linear flow with sensible names; the suffix extraction via first ';' works but would benefit from a one-line comment explaining why it is safe.
rationale.robustness: No panics on bad input, does not mutate the input array, relies on stdlib http.ParseSetCookie; defensive default branch for unknown action types.
rationale.maintainability: UnmarshalCaddyfile is a verbatim copy of CookieFilter's rather than a shared helper, so future subdirective changes must be made twice; otherwise straightforward to extend.
